rag.text:
Test: TC-947 — Feature area - Box scope - Scope definition - Modules view after revoke trello permissions
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-25 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition
Labels: teamtree

Description:
For this test case please *don't use* team-qa trello account.

You can create your own trello account for free on trello.com according to this [*instruction.*|https://wiki.softwareplant.com/display/SOFTWAREPLANT/How+to+create+Trello+account]

If you don't know how to add trello to scope definition you can read it [*here*|https://wiki.softwareplant.com/display/SOFTWAREPLANT/How+to+add+Trello+extPlatform]

 

Steps:
1. In Overview module of box HOME create a new box with scope type OWN with boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-947 Revoke Trello
   Expected: New box with boxName is created
2. Navigate to the Gantt module and  add taskName basic task
   Data: taskName: Basic
   Expected: Basic task is created
3. Navigate to Box Configration -> Tasks -> Scope definition tab of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-947 Revoke Trello
   Expected: Scope definition tab is displayed with JIRA section and button [add new integration] on the right from [save] button.
4. Click on [add new integration] button and add trello extplatform then click save
   Data: Please *don't use* team-qa trello account for this TC

instruction how to add trello is *[here|https://wiki.softwareplant.com/display/SOFTWAREPLANT/How+to+add+Trello+extPlatform]*
   Expected: Trello extplatform is added to scope definition
5. Add any Board from Trello at the Automatic rules
Click Save button
   Expected: Tasks successfully added to the scope of the box
6. Navigate to the Gantt module
   Expected: Tasks from Trello are visible on the Gantt chart and at the WBS
7. In new tab open trello account from step 3 then click on your avatar on the right top corner of the screen
   Expected: Drop down list is displayed.
8. Click on settings option then under [Aplication] setting next to BigPicture click on *[REVOKE]* button
   Expected: BigPicture dissappears form the list
9. Go back to BigPicture app Gantt module
   Data: boxName: TC-947 Revoke Trello
   Expected: All tasks are visible and treated as "no access" when extPlatform is invalid.
10. Click wrench icon in Status column and change aggregation to Children statuses in %
   Expected: Aggregation has changed
11. Go to the Board module.
   Expected: All tasks are visible and treated as "no access" when extPlatform is invalid.
